title: Color not right
text: Color not right. I thought the color was more yellow but it is gold and there is too much of it.  Returning but will pick something else as there are so many pretty choices of rugs on Amazon.

product_metadata.title: LUXE WEAVERS Abstract Area Rug (6' x 9')
features: Actual Dimension: 6 feet 5 inches width by 9 feet 2 inches length. Colors and dimensions may vary. 5x7 rug shown. Based on where you are standing, colors may appear dark, light, or muted. Brush the fibers with your hand in one direction for your desired effect.

Modern Coastal Decor: Rich blues, white, yellow gold, and grey hues create a versatile color palette to accompany dining rooms, large living rooms or bedroom décor. 6x9 accent modern blue area rugs are made to retain a soft feel for many years.

Machine-Made Rugs: Blue carpet in size 6x9 is made from 100% premium polypropylene, with a medium pile and jute backing. Give your living room or entryway a new look with Luxe Weavers area rugs and let your feet experience plush comfort.

Easy Clean: Dirt and stain-resistant 6x9 area rugs are safe for kids. Keep blue and gray area rugs in great condition with light spot-cleaning or vacuuming with no beater bar. Lay rug flat and face down for 2 to 3 days to allow ripples to relax.

Floor Decor: Eye-catching designs and rich colors turn your living room floors into artwork. Decorate a bedroom, kitchen, dining room, or hallway with a gray abstract area rug. Small spaces or large rooms, we have the perfect rug size for your home.
